description: Validation fixture set: 20 historical NWS events used to validate the StormPulse T1/T2/T3 weighted tier model. Each entry captures one claim (the object StormPulse would serve) at a stated observation snapshot, the evidence signals available at that snapshot, and the tier a NexAlert analyst assigns that claim under the documented rubric (docs/CONFIDENCE_SCORING.md). Run scripts/validate_scoring.py to compute tier alignment.
